stepExplanation:
At the critical angle, the refracted ray travels along the boundary (θ₂ = 90°). Using Snell's Law:
$$n_1 \sin\theta_c = n_2 \sin 90°$$
$$\sin\theta_c = \frac{n_2}{n_1}$$
where n₁ is the denser medium and n₂ is the less dense medium.
stepBody: Write down the formula for calculating the critical angle (θc) using the refractive indices.
